name: Snug SMP
description:
SnugSMP has been running for around eight months and regularly has 20 to 50 players online, so there is almost always someone to play, build, or explore with.

Server Features

No Resets

Simple and easy to use shop

Convenient /back command

Quests and challenges

Weekend events

Fun minigames

Building competitions

Friendly and active community

Java and Bedrock crossplay

Whether you enjoy survival, building, competitions, minigames, or meeting new players, SnugSMP has something for you.

Join SnugSMP

Java Edition: snugsmp.com

Bedrock Edition: mc.snugsmp.com

Discord: discord.gg/snugsmp
